items.headline: Albemarle Upgrade: Can Energy Storage Recharge Lithium's Leader?
items.snippet: Mizuho upgraded ALB to Outperform (PT $130) on BESS demand; 16 of 26 analysts Buy/Strong Buy; Q3 results Nov 4; ALB down >33% in 2026.

items.headline: Lithium's $100 Billion Supply Gap Hands Albemarle a Domestic Moat
items.snippet: Albemarle's Q2 Energy Storage volumes rose 11% with realized price up 61% to $19.53/kg; segment adj. EBITDA up 229% to $723M. Benchmark sees storage demand growing >60%/yr.

items.headline: Albemarle Corporation(ALB) Zacks Company Report
items.snippet: Zacks Underperform: falling lithium prices, weaker Energy Storage volumes (225-235kt 2026), $70-90M Middle East cost impact, CGP3 delayed by June 9 fire.

items.headline: Albemarle upgraded to Outperform from Neutral at Mizuho
items.snippet: Mizuho raises 2027 Energy Storage price forecast to $21k from $17k; ALB lowest-cost producer with improved balance sheet.

items.headline: Albemarle price target lowered to $135 from $230 at Argus
items.snippet: Argus cuts PT to $135 from $230, keeps Buy; lithium +67% y/y but below highs; supply/demand to improve into 2027.
